main.subtitle: Chat
main.title: Chat
main.content: Stay connected with your team through instant messaging, group conversations, audio calls, and video calls. Create groups, share conversations, and collaborate with your colleagues without switching between different communication tools.

features.subtitle: Individual Chat
features.title: Chat One-on-One with Ease
content: Connect directly with colleagues through private one-on-one conversations. Send messages and stay connected with your team throughout the workday. Make quick discussions simple without unnecessary meetings or emails.

features.subtitle: Group Chat
features.title: Bring Your Team Together
content: Create group conversations for teams, projects, departments, or specific discussions. Add multiple members and keep everyone connected in a shared conversation. Keep important team conversations organized in one central place.

features.subtitle: Create Groups
features.title: Create Groups for Every Team
content: Create new groups and bring the right people together for every conversation. Add members based on teams, projects, departments, or specific work requirements. Give each group a clear purpose and keep related conversations in one place.

features.subtitle: Audio Calls
features.title: Talk Clearly with Audio Calls
content: Start an audio call directly from your individual or group conversation. Connect with colleagues instantly when messaging is not enough. Use audio calls for quick discussions, updates, and team collaboration. Stay connected without needing to switch to another communication platform.

demo.subtitle: Weblings demo
demo.title: See Weblings Workspace in Action
demo.description: Watch a quick demo showing how Weblings Workspace helps teams stay organized, collaborate effectively, and streamline daily operations.

comparison.title: How much you can save
comparison.titleDescription: Replace expensive software by replacing multiple software tools with one unified workspace. Pay only for what your team needs and scale as your business grows.
